ACCESSORIALS & REQUIREMENTS
Accessorial Terms
Detention: $75/hour after 2 hours of free time, subject to broker approval and documented arrival/departure times.
Layover: $250/day when approved by broker.
Truck Ordered Not Used (TONU): $150 when approved by broker.
Required Documents
Carrier must submit the following documents for payment processing: signed Bill of Lading (BOL), signed Proof of Delivery (POD), carrier
invoice referencing load BRF-94726, and any documentation supporting approved accessorial charges.
Carrier Instructions
• Carrier must immediately report delays, accidents, cargo issues, rejected freight, or appointment problems to the broker.
• Carrier may not double-broker, reassign, transfer, or subcontract this shipment without prior written broker authorization.
• Carrier is responsible for verifying pickup and delivery information before departure.
• Carrier must protect all shipping documents and provide complete, legible paperwork.
• Any accessorial charge requires supporting documentation and broker approval.
• This sample document is fictional and intended for LoadPacket software testing and demonstration.
